python3 -c "
import statistics

data = [33749, 34934, 43186, 48511, 45798, 47802, 74809, 83318]
# Using population standard deviation
stdev = statistics.pstdev(data)
print(f'Population standard deviation: {stdev:.4f}')

# Using sample standard deviation  
stdev_sample = statistics.stdev(data)
print(f'Sample standard deviation: {stdev_sample:.4f}')

# Also calculate with higher precision
import math
mean = sum(data) / len(data)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / len(data)
pop_stdev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f'Population stdev (precise): {pop_stdev:.10f}')
"

# Verify exact calculation
data = [33747, 34934, 43186, 48511, 45798, 47802, 74809, 83318]
print('Data values:', data)

# Mean
mean = sum(data) / len(data)
print('Mean:', mean)

# Squared differences
for x in data:
    print(f'{x}: diff={x-mean}, sq={(x-mean)**2}')

# Population variance and stdev  
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / len(data)
stdev = variance ** 0.5
print(f'Population variance: {variance}')
print(f'Population stdev: {stdev}')
print(f'Rounded to 4 dp: {stdev:.4f}')
"
